sections.html:
Pleasant Grove is a city in Utah County and part of the Provo-Orem metropolitan area, covering 9.18 square miles of land at about 4,623 feet. Its ZIP code is 84062.

Battle Creek Canyon lies above town, and Battle Creek Falls, about 50 feet tall, is in that canyon. A large white G marks the hillside, in the same way that the Y does in Provo. The county around it is large: Utah County had 659,399 residents in the 2020 census and is estimated at 759,859 for 2025.

sections.h2: Why was Pleasant Grove first called Battle Creek?
sections.html:
The settlement took the name Battle Creek from an 1849 clash between Mormon settlers and a small band of Ute people, and it was later renamed for a nearby cottonwood grove. It was settled in 1850, and the city was incorporated on January 18, 1855.

During the Walker Indian War of the 1850s, residents built a fort covering about sixteen city blocks. It is gone now, but memorial cornerstones mark the old outline. The city's nickname is Utah's City of Trees, and Strawberry Days, first held on June 21, 1922, still takes place in the third week of June with a rodeo, parades and a carnival.

sections.h2: What do Census figures say about Pleasant Grove housing?
sections.html:
Pleasant Grove is mostly owner-occupied. The Census Bureau puts the owner rate at 66.0% for 2020 to 2024, and the city has barely changed from a 2020 base of 37,721, with an estimate of 37,773 on July 1, 2025.

sections.h2: What is the weather like, and what does it mean for a house?
sections.html:
Pleasant Grove has cold winters and hot, dry summers. Average annual precipitation is 16.43 inches, average snowfall is 41.4 inches, and the recorded extremes run from 104 degrees to minus 19.

  • Snow load: a roof that has been patched or has aging shingles gets tested every winter.
  • Heating: a furnace near the end of its life shows up quickly in a cold January.
  • Cooling: summers are hot and dry, so the age of the air conditioner tends to come up.

None of these have to be fixed for an as-is cash sale, but they are the items that tend to come up when a conventional buyer's inspector walks through.

sections.h2: Which schools serve Pleasant Grove, and what changes in 2027?
sections.html:
Alpine School District runs the public schools today, and it will be dissolved on July 1, 2027. Pleasant Grove is assigned to the new Timpanogos district together with Orem, Lindon and Vineyard under the June 2026 resource agreement reported by the Herald Extra.

Charter options already in town include John Hancock Charter School and Lincoln Academy, and Liahona Preparatory Academy is an accredited private K-12 school. Families comparing houses in Pleasant Grove will want to confirm which attendance area an address falls into, since district names and boundaries are in motion.

sections.h2: How do people commute from Pleasant Grove?
sections.html:
The mean commute for Pleasant Grove workers is 21.7 minutes, a bit longer than in Orem or Provo.

Utah Valley University in Orem and Brigham Young University in Provo are both major employers in the county, with UVU reporting 3,030 jobs in Orem and BYU in the 5,000 to 6,999 range in Provo. Commute times to those campuses are a practical detail for a seller to include.

sections.h2: What do Pleasant Grove's zoning definitions say about accessory apartments?
sections.html:
If the house has a basement apartment or another second unit, ask the Pleasant Grove planning office how the city treats it before you list. A buyer's lender and the title company will both want to know whether the unit is allowed.

  • A family can be one person living alone, or people related by blood, marriage, adoption or guardianship plus up to two unrelated people who pay no rent.
  • A family can also be up to four related or unrelated people living as one housekeeping unit.
  • A tiny home is a subordinate dwelling in a detached accessory structure of at least 192 square feet, on a permanent foundation with all required utilities.

These definitions come from the code's definitions section, and the specific permit or registration steps for an apartment are set elsewhere. If your Pleasant Grove house has a basement unit, confirm with the city how it was approved before you list it.

sections.h2: What does the wider Utah County market around Pleasant Grove look like?
sections.html:
Pleasant Grove sits in the Provo-Orem area, which the Utah County article on Wikipedia places among the top eight U.S. metropolitan areas by percentage growth. Utah Lake fills a large part of the valley at about 4,487 feet above sea level, and the Wasatch Range lines the east side.

The county's median household income was $77,057 in the source's figures, and 28.5% of residents 25 and older held a bachelor's degree. Pleasant Grove's own numbers, with a median household income of $101,073, are higher than that county figure. Provo and Orem together draw a commuting student population of more than 70,000 to BYU and UVU, which shapes traffic and rentals across the valley. In 2008 the U.S. Supreme Court even heard a case from the city, Pleasant Grove City v. Summum, about a privately donated monument on public property.

sections.h2: How does property tax work for a Pleasant Grove house?
sections.html:
Utah County assesses and bills Pleasant Grove homes. The valuation notice arrives at the end of July, and a market-value appeal to the county Board of Equalization is due by September 15. Late appeals that meet extra criteria can be filed through March 31.

The tax notice comes between mid and late October. Primary residences are taxed on 55% of market value after the 45% exemption, if someone occupies the home at least 183 consecutive days a year. The Utah County Assessor may send a new owner a declaration form after a change of ownership, and a rental not occupied full-time by an eligible occupant is treated as a secondary residence. The Treasurer's number for payoffs on delinquent tax is 801-851-8255.

sections.h2: How is a Pleasant Grove deed recorded?
sections.html:
The Utah County Recorder records deeds for Pleasant Grove properties from 100 East Center Street, Suite 1300, in Provo. The office accepts documents that meet state recording requirements, and it does not prepare or notarize documents, interpret them, give legal advice or run title searches.

In a sale, the title or escrow company usually handles the filing. The Recorder also offers Property Watch, which emails you when a document is recorded against a property you monitor. The phone number is 801-851-8179.

sections.h2: What do Pleasant Grove sellers usually face, and how does a cash sale work?
sections.html:
Common situations in Pleasant Grove include an inherited house, a home that needs a new roof or furnace, a basement apartment with unclear paperwork, or a move that cannot wait for a listing to run its course. A cash sale to us follows a short path: you tell us about the property, we review it, and we make an offer based on condition.

We buy as-is, and you do not repair or clean. A title or escrow company handles the closing, and the deed is recorded with the county.

faqs.q: How big is Pleasant Grove, Utah?
faqs.a: Pleasant Grove covers 9.18 square miles of land and had 37,726 residents at the 2020 census, according to Wikipedia. The Census Bureau estimates 37,773 for July 1, 2025.

faqs.q: Which school district will Pleasant Grove homes belong to after 2027?
faqs.a: Pleasant Grove is assigned to the new Timpanogos district, which replaces Alpine School District on July 1, 2027. Check the boundary map for your address.

faqs.q: When must a Pleasant Grove property tax appeal be filed?
faqs.a: The deadline is September 15 for an appeal to the Utah County Board of Equalization. The county accepts appeals online, by email, by mail or in person.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Pleasant Grove house with an unapproved basement apartment?
faqs.a: Yes. We buy houses as they are, so you do not need to settle the status of the apartment first. It is still wise to ask the city how it was approved, since the answer affects how a conventional buyer would see it.

faqs.q: What is Strawberry Days in Pleasant Grove?
faqs.a: Strawberry Days is a city celebration first held on June 21, 1922, and it usually runs in the third week of June with a rodeo, parades and a carnival.
